VIA HD Audio Driver is an all-in-one sound card driver utility that can prepare your home PC to accurately recognize and fully access all the capabilities offered by your VIA audio hardware.

It was created to be used easily by both novices who just want their home PC or laptop to work as intended and seasoned professionals who are optimizing a large number of PCs for stability and correct use every day.

VIA is one of the largest suppliers of audio processing chips on the market, and its hardware is being built into hundreds of motherboard models each year, reaching a significant percentage of all PC users around the world.

However, their audio hardware cannot properly be utilized by your Windows OS if it does not have access to the proper driver â a software package that can help Windows OS to properly detect, communicate, utilize supported audio standards, and take advantage of all audio processing and output capabilities offered by the audio hardware.

Windows OS can usually come with some generic and basic audio driver, often without any advanced functions or even the capability to output audio in high quality.

VIA HD Audio Driver aims to provide you with a one-click solution for full driver support for a wide array of VIA audio chips.

Features and Highlights

- All-in-one driver package for VIA HDaudio chips.
- Support for both integrated and standalone audio chips.
- A streamlined interface and driver installation.
- Enhanced stability of Windows OS during the encoding or decoding of audio content.
- Built-in support for VIA device models such as VT1705, VT1802P, VT1819S, VT1708S, VR2021, and others.

- Available for all modern versions of Windows OS (XP, 7, Vista, 8, 10, 11)
- Full support for both 32-bit and 64-bit operating systems.
